KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a Social Media Manager to join our team! You will own organic social for both brands end to end across every social channel. You decide what each account is for, who it should bring in and what content grows it. Then you plan it, create it, publish it every day and adjust based on what the numbers tell you. This isn't a role for keeping the lights on: we want someone who will transform our socials and turn them into a super-engaged community that people actually want to be part of.
 You report to our Influencers & Partnerships Manager and have a designer for bigger creative pieces, but the thinking is yours and you're strong on graphics and short-form video yourself. We are looking for someone with 2+ years running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand, who has personally created and published the content and can show the accounts they grew and the numbers they moved.
 The mission of this role
 Own organic social for KittySpout and DoggySpout end to end across all social media channels. Success is accounts that keep growing and reach people who have never heard of us, with content created and published every day that grows an active, engaged community.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday – test a new format, hook or post style every week, keep what works and improve the calendar and reporting along the way.
 Speed Is King – get a trend live the day it's spotted, publish on time every day and answer the community within 24 hours.
 Work Smart – use AI and tools so your time goes to strategy and creating: batch and schedule posts ahead, let Claude draft hook and caption variations, and automate the Monday report.
 Overdeliver – bring new content ideas to the Influencers & Partnerships Manager before being asked, and tell the team fast when something flops and what you're changing.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. 
 Grow the audience on both brands – follower growth by brand and platform (Instagram, TikTok and Facebook insights)
 Reach people who have never heard of us – reach and non-follower reach per post by brand (platform insights)
 Content people save and share – saves, shares and engagement rate by brand (platform insights)
 Publish daily to plan on both brands – posts published per week per brand vs the content calendar (scheduling tool)
 An active, responsive community – comments and DMs answered within 24 hours, Facebook group activity (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok)
 Key Objectives
 Own the organic content strategy for KittySpout and DoggySpout across all social media channels.
 Plan the content calendar one week ahead per brand and platform, mixing content for the existing community with content built to reach new audiences.
 Create and publish every day: write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, and design day-to-day graphics and stories.
 Spot trends daily and get trend content live the same day.
 Turn the creator and UGC content from our creator programs into organic posts that perform.
 Run the community: comments, DMs, our Facebook group and tagged mentions.
 Read the data every week and act on it: double down on what works and drop what doesn't.
 Fully remote, full-time
 Native-level written English
 Hands-on Organic Social: 2+ years personally running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand – creating and publishing the content yourself, not just approving it or managing an agency.
 Proof: Accounts you grew and numbers you moved. We will ask for this.
 Multi-brand, Multi-platform: You can run two brands across every social channel and tailor content to each instead of copying the same post everywhere.
 Design: You build clean, on-brand graphics and stories in Canva, Figma or similar without waiting on a designer.
 Hooks, Captions & Video: You write hooks that stop the scroll and shoot and edit short-form video to a solid standard.
 Trend Spotting: You're on TikTok and Instagram every day and spot trends before they peak.
 Data-driven: You read saves, shares, reach and engagement and change what you make because of it.
 Time Zone: Overlap with the US and Canada, where most of our audience is.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
 Bonus points: pet, home or wellness brand experience; working with creators or UGC.
 Accountabilities
 What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week. 
 Content strategy and calendar – Own the organic content strategy for both brands, plan next week's calendar per brand and platform and get it approved with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager, and get trend content live the same day.

 Creator content – Review the creator and UGC content coming in from our creator programs, repurpose the best of it for organic, and feed back to the creator team on what works.
 Community – Reply to all comments and DMs within 24 hours across both brands, keep the Facebook group active, engage with tagged mentions, and flag customer issues to Customer Support the same day.
 Planning and reporting – Post daily priorities, deliver a performance report every Monday (what worked, what didn't and what you're changing), set organic social KPI targets with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager and update them on the department scorecard weekly, and join the weekly team meeting.
 How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate
 (1) Application + Screening

 USD $3,000 – $4,500 per month (based on experience and expertise).

Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.
 Position Overview/Mandate: 
 The DSP Designer plays a key role in developing and delivering complex signal processing algorithms for Fidus clients, from concept through simulation, fixed-point implementation, and hardware bring-up. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus FPGA/hardware teams to design algorithms, perform quantization and bit-width analysis, and translate DSP concepts into feasible hardware architectures.
 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys moving between application domains (communications, radar/sensing, industrial, medical), is comfortable working across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary, and takes pride in producing well-documented, bit-true designs.
 Make an Impact with US: 
 At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.
 In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.
 What You'll Be Doing: 
 Develop and simulate DSP algorithms (equalization, filtering, estimation, detection) in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python, from concept through fixed-point validation
 Perform quantization/bit-width analysis and produce bit-true fixed-point models suitable for HDL implementation
 Collaborate with FPGA/HDL and hardware teams to translate algorithms into feasible hardware architectures (pipelining, MAC/resource budgeting, timing closure)
 Support HDL verification through golden-model test vectors and co-simulation
 Support lab bring-up, characterization, and tuning of DSP-based hardware against real-world channel/sensor behavior
 Adapt existing DSP toolkits to new client domains and standards across multiple engagements (e.g., Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor)
 Document algorithm design decisions, trade-offs, and validation results for client and internal reference
 Who You are: 
 BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related field
 Strong foundation in signals and systems: Fourier/Z-transform, digital filter design (FIR/IIR), sampling theory
 Practical experience with estimation/detection theory (e.g., matched filtering, MMSE, Kalman filtering) or adaptive filtering (LMS/RLS)
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python for algorithm design and simulation
 Experience with fixed-point conversion and quantization trade-off analysis
 Demonstrated ability to work across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary (collaborating directly with HDL/FPGA teams)
 Strong verbal and written communication skills - ability to explain algorithm trade-offs to non-DSP stakeholders
 Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
 Location and travel: Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.
 This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).
 Nice to Have: 
 Experience in one or more of: optical/wireless communications, radar/sensing, motor control, biomedical signal processing, semiconductor test
 Experience with high-speed SerDes and PAM4 signaling (e.g., PCIe Gen6, 400G/800G Ethernet electrical) - equalization (FFE/CTLE/DFE), link training, and FEC awareness

 Experience adapting quickly across multiple industries or client domains (consulting/services background a plus)
 Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to signal processing on FPGAs, GPUs, NPUs, or CPUs
 Experience with dedicated DSP processors (e.g., Analog Devices, Texas Instruments)
 Experience with RF front-end systems and data converter interfaces (ADC/DAC), including digital up/down-conversion (DUC/DDC)

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

As an Account Executive focused on high-velocity sales in Canada, you will drive Ramp’s growth by closing a large volume of small, repeatable deals with speed and consistency. This role is designed for sellers who thrive in fast sales cycles, high activity, and a process-drive environment. You’ll primarily sell to small businesses and early-stage companies, running a transactional sales motion that emphasizes quick qualification, clear ROI, and rapid decision-making. You’ll work closely with SDRs, efficiently move deals forward, and help Ramp scale its presence across Canada.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Close a high volume of deals by managing opportunities from first contact to signature in short, efficient sales cycles.

 - Quickly qualify prospects based on firmographics, use case, and urgency, advancing strong-fit deals and disqualifying others early.

 - Run concise, repeatable demos and sales conversations focused on immediate value, ease of adoption, and clear next steps.

 - Manage a large pipeline of simultaneous opportunities, maintaining responsiveness and momentum across all accounts.

 - Hit weekly and monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue targets in a metrics-driven sales environment.

 - Maintain clean CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and disciplined follow-up in Salesforce.

 - Provide ongoing feedback on SMB objections, competitive trends, and process improvements to help optimize Ramp’s velocity sales motion.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 1-2 years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in an SMB, transactional, or high-velocity closing role.

 - Proven ability to consistently close a high number of small deals per month (20–30+ deals/month)

 - Experience selling to founders, owners, and operators at small businesses with straightforward, value-focused messaging.

 - Ability to stay highly organized while managing dozens of active deals at once.

 - Comfort working off clear metrics and operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - This is an in-office role in Toronto, 5 days per week. This is not a remote role.

 - Experience selling into very small businesses or early-stage startups.

 Fluent communication skills in English are required and bilingual skills in French are an asset

Project 
 The Woodfibre LNG Project is located approximately 7 km west-southwest of Squamish, British Columbia. It involves the construction and operation of a liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility on the previous Woodfibre pulp mill site, which will have a storage capacity of 250,000 m3 and would produce approximately 2.1 million tons per year of LNG.
 Woodfibre Management Ltd. is a privately held Canadian company based in Vancouver and a subsidiary of Pacific Energy Corporation Limited.
 Position 
 The Loading Master is an integral part of Woodfibre LNG ’s dynamic team and will be responsible for all the activities related to mooring and loading of LNG carriers berthing at Woodfibre’s floating storage and marine terminals facility. The successful candidate will report to the Marine Manager and will join early in the project execution phase to support the operations readiness effort for an efficient transition to the operations phase and to support the company’s objective of becoming a safe, reliable and efficient LNG producer in BC, Canada.
 Responsibilities 
 During the Project Execution phase, the successful applicant will:
 Support the implementation of the long term marine service provider agreements including tugs, personnel transport and logistics.
 Ensure implementation of company’s TERMPOL and other marine related recommendations and commitments prior to start of operations.
 Support the development of the Marine training plan
 Input to Marine budget and management of related costs
 Lead and participate as required in the development of the Company’s marine operating procedures, terminal operations manual, marine emergency and security plans to ensure they meet industry best practices and to the satisfaction of local regulators and authorities.
 General technical support for the development of other marine services necessary for the plant’s operations
 Assisting in the commissioning and start-up of the Terminal’s Marine facilities cooldown and first cargo 
 During the Operational phase, the successful applicant will:
 Act as the Terminal Representative ensuring that LNGC’s mooring, and cargo operations are conducted safely and in accordance with the terminal operating procedures and in line with industry best practices.
 Loading Master provides the key interface between the vessel and the Terminal coordinating activities and ensuring that a high level of communication is maintained to manage any issues that may arise effectively.
 Act as an Alternate Port Facility Security Officer.
 Responsible for pre-arrival correspondences with concerned parties, Supervise, pre arrival checks, Berthing, Mooring and Un-berthing of LNG Tankers, Declaration of Security, Conduct Pre-load meetings with vessel's senior officers, carry out Pre-load safety inspection. Maintain Marine Operational oversight of the cargo transfer operation and will be in attendance for all critical activities to ensure the safe and on time completion of loading operation, conduct periodical safety inspections and completion of cargo documentation including (SOF, LOP, NOR etc).
 Witness cargo surveys and ensure all required information is gathered to support commercial deliverables.
 Maintain the LNG Tankers' compatibility studies and support marine assurance vessel pre-approval activities.
 Provide technical support to logistics team, inspect contracted service boats such as barges and other supply vessels, as needed.
 Provide marine expertise to operations in respect of trim and stability management of the floating storage tanks.
 Fulfill necessary duties as part of the Emergency Response command team as defined by the company.
 Take an active role in HSSE activities; support Operations Excellence initiatives and capability development.
 Requirements and Experience 
 Experience as a Master Mariner or Chief Officer for LNG carriers or other liquified gases ships
 Minimum 3 years’ experience as a Loading Master in LNG terminals
 Experience in floating LNG facilities FLNG preferred, FSRU and FSU will be considered
 Experience in the marine assurance activities such as vessel compatibility assessments, SIRE inspections, MTMSA. 
 General experience in the various marine activities related to the operations of an LNG terminal, including contracting marine services, agency, pilotage, marine logistics.
 Right to work in Canada preferred, candidates with FLNG experience may be eligible for relocation assistance.
 Must be able to communicate fluently in written and spoken English. 
 Education 
 Unlimited Master Mariner certificate or unlimited Chief/cargo Officer certificates
 Dangerous cargo endorsements - Liquefied gas Tanker, Oil or Chemical Tankers. 
 Skills 
 Highly motivated, team-oriented, strong analytic skills. Ability to identify problems and successfully implement solutions.
 Be comfortable with a broad interface management role, collaborating with multiple disciplines when required.
 Ability to solve technical problems as they arise and make decisions on how a problem’s solution will impact the immediate problem and the system.
 Must be flexible with work hours, overtime, holidays and weekends, as required, to support ship’s schedule, as needed.
 Willing to comply with WLNG’s drug-free and harassment-free work environment and comply with all safety policies and procedures.
 Have good organizational, computer and communication skills working in a team environment. 
 Expertise with a variety of computer programs (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Navisworks, Adobe Acrobat)
 Only qualified candidates legally entitled to work in Canada will be contacted. 
 Woodfibre Management Ltd.  is an equal opportunity employer.
 Thank you in advance for your interest!
 Benefits
 Salary range: CAD $145,000 - $180,000/yr
